summary.text: Barbara Dittrich is a Republican member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 99 since 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.

paragraphs.text: Barbara Dittrich was born in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, and has served in the Assembly since 2019.

In the 2025-2026 session she chairs the Insurance Committee, is vice-chair of the Small Business Development Committee, and serves on the Children and Families, Education, Health, Mental Health, Rules, and Workforce Development committees.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Dittrich listed economic stability, educational freedom (including educational choice) and election integrity as her key campaign messages.
